limitations: SHSH vs DHDH acquisition-mode difference requires scientific comparability review.
Shared HHHH layer alone does not establish full cross-mode comparability.
Pixel differences are not a water mask, flood classification, river-stage measurement, flow-rate measurement or flood forecast.
AOI is not a surveyed river centreline or floodplain boundary.
A two-date, 12-day pair cannot establish a seasonal trend.
